description: This file defines the AssignNameExpression class in the Twig templating engine. It extends NameExpression and manages the assignment of variable names within Twig templates, including deprecation warnings and syntax error handling for invalid assignments.

classes.name: AssignNameExpression
classes.description: Represents a variable name assignment expression in Twig, handling deprecation, validation, and compilation of the variable assignment syntax.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the expression with a name and line number, triggers deprecation warning for the class, and validates that the name is not a reserved keyword.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the expression into PHP code, outputting the variable assignment in the Twig context array.
